meta.name: swarm-phases-10
meta.label: Phases with gates (Bun)
meta.about: Bun's way: one shared tree, each file owned by one agent (no branches, no merges). Phase 1 moves the modules, phase 2 points every importer at them, phase 3 deletes the shims; main may be red inside a phase, and the next phase starts only when the check is green. The goal: move Hono's src/utils/ (27 modules) to src/lib/ — 140 tasks (moves, import rewrites in 87 files, shim deletions), dependencies from the import graph, a real type check (tsgo, tests included). No model calls.
